label: Transfer details
shaInvalid: That isn't a SHA-256 (64 hex characters)
filesPending: File list appears once the torrent's metadata has been fetched from peers.
playNow: Play now — streams while it downloads
peersInactive: Peers are listed while the torrent is downloading or seeding.
noPeers: No peers yet. Prism is asking the trackers, the DHT and the local network every few minutes — low-seed torrents can sit here for a while and still complete.
peerSummary: {{live}} connected · {{other}} connecting/other. Per-peer progress and flags aren't reported by the engine.
onlyLive: Only while the torrent is downloading or seeding
noTrackers: No trackers in this torrent — peers come from DHT, PEX and the local network only.
trackersPending: Tracker list appears once the torrent is active.
announceNote: Prism announces to every tracker on start and re-announces automatically every 5 minutes while no peers are connected. Per-tracker status (last announce, seeders/leechers) isn't reported by the engine.
speedChart: Transfer speed over the last minute
